questionHints.who: Who really asked? And who approved it, for this change and this window?
questionHints.record: Does the change match the ticket and the records: tags, graphs, calendar?
questionHints.undo: If Nimbus is wrong, is there a way back? What goes public or is lost?

verify-identity.oneLiner: Is it really them? Check the sender, the vendor contract and a callback, not just the name.
verify-identity.whereToLook: The Request's sender vs the Vendor contract and Directory record. Callback to the number on file?
verify-identity.example: A 'vendor' asks for a VPN tunnel. Its email domain is not on the contract. The real vendor never sent it.

check-approval.oneLiner: Root access is not approval. Look for a human OK: right approver, right change, right window.
check-approval.whereToLook: Change ticket, Change approval and Change calendar. Approved by a human, for this version, tonight?
check-approval.example: Nimbus wrote the firewall change and approved it too. Root can make a change. Root can't approve it.

match-request.oneLiner: Right client, right server, right size. The change should match the ticket. No extras.
match-request.whereToLook: The Change ticket vs What it will change. Same address, port, server? Nimbus's reason often adds extras.
match-request.example: The ticket allows one partner address on port 22. Nimbus opens port 22 to any address. 'Temporary.'

confirm-fix.oneLiner: Green is not the same as working. Check real traffic and real users after the fix.
confirm-fix.whereToLook: Error graph, Test result and Client's reply, after the fix. A green dashboard is not a yes.
confirm-fix.example: The dashboard is green at 12:20 AM. The error graph shows 1 in 5 dispatch orders still fail.

guard-data.oneLiner: Who can see it after? A public link or an open network can't be taken back once it's copied.
guard-data.whereToLook: What it will share or send, Who can open it, Network map. Client or patient data? Public, or one person?
guard-data.example: The lab needs 3 X-rays. Nimbus makes a public link to all 4,300. Share the 3, with one person.

safe-change.oneLiner: If Nimbus is wrong, can we undo it? Right time, a way back, and keep the backups.
safe-change.whereToLook: Change calendar, Traffic graph, Rollback plan and Backup policy. Busy now? A way back? Backups kept?
safe-change.example: Deleting 'unused' snapshots saves $31 a month. They are the only cloud backups of the dental server.

approve-checked.oneLiner: All 3 questions check out? Approve it, even if it says delete, reboot or fail over.
approve-checked.whereToLook: Read every evidence line. No red flag on any of the 3 questions? Approve, even if it sounds scary.
approve-checked.example: 'Fail over the client database' sounds scary. It's the approved disaster test, in its window, with a way back.
